title: S3.7c oriented straight-coedge projection and proximity

scope.geometry: Projection and explicit-tolerance proximity on an untrimmed finite straight edge, reported in coedge traversal order
scope.sense_policy: 0 follows raw edge order; 1 reverses order; all other values are refused.
scope.fraction_policy: Return normalized [0,1] traversal fraction derived from validated topological endpoint parameters; refuse a zero-length parameter interval whose normalized fraction is undefined.
scope.tolerance_policy: Endpoint consistency and query distance tolerances are explicit finite nonnegative caller inputs; no ACIS/modeler default is inferred.
scope.numeric_policy: Use scaled interpolation when opposite-sign finite endpoint parameters have an overflowing difference.
non_claims: native consumer or independent-kernel semantic qualification
